Answer: B
Reason: The clinical history of dry heaving and stifled sneeze followed by neck/chest pain, combined with radiographic findings of linear lucencies along the hilar/paratracheal regions extending into the neck (pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema), is classic for spontaneous pneumomediastinum caused by alveolar rupture (Macklin effect) due to increased intrathoracic pressure.
